'''V-Guard Industries Ltd''' is an Indian [[Power electronics|electrical]]s and [[home appliances]] manufacturer, headquartered in [[Kochi]]. The company manufactures [[Voltage regulator|voltage stabilizer]]s, [[electrical cable]], electric [[pump]]s, [[electric motors]], [[Water heating|geysers]], solar water heaters, [[electric fans]] and [[Uninterruptible power supply|UPS]]s. It was founded in 1977 by [[Kochouseph Chittilappilly]] as a small voltage stabilizer manufacturing unit.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.theweekendleader.com/Success/3112/guarding-your-gadgets.html|title=With Rs 1 lakh he started a stabiliser brand, which has now grown into a Rs 4100 crore turnover conglomerate. In FY 23 V-Guard acquired Sunflame brand of kitchen appliances |work=The weekend leader}}</ref>

==History==
The company started in 1977, when [[Kochouseph Chittilappilly]] set out to build a brand in the Indian electric and electronic goods industry. The company started with a small manufacturing unit for voltage stabilizers, a capital of {{currency|100000|INR}} and two employees. The Kangaroo logo was created by artist V. A. Sreekandan (Mani).

Over the years V-Guard has sold into domestic, industrial and agricultural electronic goods and appliances category. It is listed on the [[National Stock Exchange of India|NSE]] and [[Bombay Stock Exchange|BSE]] since its [[initial public offering]] in 2008.<ref>{{cite news |title=V-Guard sets IPO price band at Rs 80-85/share |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/ipos/fpos/v-guard-sets-ipo-price-band-at-rs-80-85/share/articleshow/2755939.cms |access-date=15 June 2023 |work=The Economic Times |date=4 February 2008}}</ref>

==Operations==
V-Guard is a consumer goods company with diversified product offerings. Headquartered in the city of [[Kochi]], Kerala, the company has over 400 distributors, 100,000 retailers and 35 branches across India as of 2023.

As of March 2023, V-Guard operated 11 plants across India employing over 4500 people.<ref>{{cite web|title=V-Guard to set up three new factories, plans push in kitchen appliances, fans and air coolers|url=https://www.fortuneindia.com//story/enterprise/v-guard-to-set-up-three-new-factories-plans-push-in-kitchen-appliances-fans-and-air-coolers/112025|date=2022-12-09|author= P B Jayakumar|access-date=2024-11-15|website=Fortune India}}</ref>

On March 6, 2024, the group announced that its subsidiary has launched the commercial production of kitchen appliances at the company's factory in [[Vapi]], Gujarat.<ref>{{cite web|title=V-Guard Industries subsidiary begins commercial production at Gujarat manufacturing unit|url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/v-guard-industries-subsidiary-begins-commercial-production-at-gujarat-manufacturing-unit-19211441.htm/|date=2024-03-06|access-date=2024-11-15|website=CNBC TV18}}</ref>

In FY 23 V-Guard acquired Sunflame brand of kitchen appliances.<ref>{{cite web|title=V-Guard Industries to acquire Sunflame Enterprises for ₹660 crore|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/v-guard-industries-to-acquire-100-stake-in-sunflame-enterprises-for-660-crore/article66243088.ece//|date=2022-12-09|access-date=2024-11-15|website=Hindu BusinessLine}}</ref>

==Management==
The company's current managing director, Mithun Chittilappilly is a Post Graduate in Management from the [[University of Melbourne|University Of Melbourne, Australia]]. In the year 2006, he joined V-Guard as the executive director and in 2012, he was appointed as the managing director of the company. Mithun Chittilappilly has previously worked with leading MNCs like [[Deloitte]] & [[Hewlett-Packard|Hewlett Packard]].

Chairman and founder, [[Kochouseph Chittilappilly]] was born in 1950 in [[Thrissur district|Thrissur]], [[Kerala]], into a family traditionally engaged in agriculture. He holds a master's degree in Physics and began his career as a Supervisor in an electronics company. He is one of the founder promoters and was also the acting managing director of the company till in April 2012, he passed the baton on to his son Mithun Chittilappilly.

==Affiliate companies==

V-Guard has 3 subsidiaries - Sunflame, GUTS electromech and V-Guard consumer products

V-Guard also sells Simon electric brand of switches for India market under partnership with Spanish company Simon electric.<ref>{{cite web|title=V-Guard net revenue grows 7.6% in Q4 FY23|url=https://www.google.com//s/www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/v-guard-net-revenue-grows-76-in-q4-fy23/article66911684.ece//|date=2023-05-31|access-date=2024-11-15|website=Hindu BusinessLine}}</ref>

[[Kochouseph Chittilappilly]] also founded other establishments held as subsidiaries<ref>Public disclosure of V-Guard http://www.sebi.gov.in/dp/vguardfinal.pdf</ref> such as [[V-Star Creations]], an Indian manufacturer of innerwear for men, women, and children, and [[Wonderla]], a chain of amusement parks in South India.<ref>[https://www.vguard.in/about-voltage-stabilizers/water-pumps/ V-Guard Industries Official Website.]</ref><ref>[https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/features/investment-world/stock-insight/article2580221.ece The Hindu BusinessLine. Stock Insight: V-Guard Industries.]</ref>
